name: text-utils
title: Text Utils
description: 30 deterministic text transformation commands for replacing, counting, extracting, and manipulating text
author: degouville

commands.name: text-utils
commands.title: Text Utils
commands.subtitle: All tools
commands.description: All text transformations in one list view with before/after preview and AI features

commands.name: double-quote-to-single-quote
commands.title: Double Quote to Single Quote
commands.subtitle: Replace
commands.description: Replace double quotes with single quotes

commands.name: single-quote-to-double-quote
commands.title: Single Quote to Double Quote
commands.subtitle: Replace
commands.description: Replace single quotes with double quotes

commands.name: smart-quotes-to-straight
commands.title: Smart Quotes to Straight
commands.subtitle: Replace
commands.description: Replace smart/curly quotes with straight quotes

commands.name: extract-ids
commands.title: Extract IDs
commands.subtitle: Extract
commands.description: Extract UUIDs and numeric IDs from text

commands.name: single-to-double-newlines
commands.title: Single to Double Newlines
commands.subtitle: Lines
commands.description: Convert single newlines to double newlines

commands.name: double-to-single-newlines
commands.title: Double to Single Newlines
commands.subtitle: Lines
commands.description: Convert double newlines to single newlines

commands.name: wrap-lines-at-length
commands.title: Wrap Lines at Length
commands.subtitle: Lines
commands.description: Wrap lines at specified character count

commands.name: trim-whitespace
commands.title: Trim Whitespace
commands.subtitle: Transform
commands.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from each line

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
